title: LangChain — the four primitives
blurb: Model interoperability, RAG, agents and memory — the building blocks of most LLM apps.
body:
LangChain's four headline features map cleanly onto what most production LLM apps actually need:

  • Model Interoperability — swap between LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) with minimal code changes.
  • Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) — tools to connect LLMs to private data sources like PDFs, databases and web pages for context-aware responses.
  • Agents — systems where the LLM decides which tools to use and in what order to complete a task.
  • Memory — utilities for maintaining conversation history across multiple interactions.
